title: Slovakian Clam Pilaf
description: A hearty and flavorful Slovakian-inspired dish featuring clams, rice, and spices.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add chopped onion and sauté until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add clams, white wine, water, salt, and black pepper.
Stir to combine, then bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 5-7 minutes, or until clams open.
Stir in pilaf according to package instructions.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until pilaf is cooked through.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped parsley.
